outcome: Authenticated operators can run a faster Biz report, see bounded progress, and review durable run history attributed to each admin.
authorizationBoundary: Candidate implementation and verification only; no production publication without explicit instruction.
invariants: cached summaries do not confirm bookings
admin authorization and same-origin checks remain
acceptance: Twelve targets are processed per bounded wave.
Progress shows processed, total and percentage.
Every started run persists actor, period, scope, status and counts.
History survives reload and is visible only to authorized admins.
Stop is actor-bound and cannot stop another admin's run.
